ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT by 1055-1057SECONDAVENUELLC and 1061SECONDAVE.LLC Dated as of: November 17, 2025 Block:1329 Lots:25,26,27and 28 NewYork,NewYork RECORDANDRETURNTO: Herrick, Feinstein LLP 2ParkAvenue New York, NY 10016 Attention: Michael A. Smith, Esq.

ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement") made as of November 17, 2025 (the “Effective Date") by 1055-1057 SECOND AVENUE LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o Junction Management LLC, 36 West 44th Street, Suite 630, New York, New York 10063 ("1055-1057 Owner") and 1061 SECOND AVE. LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o Junction Management LLC, 36 West 44th Street, Suite 630, New York, New York 10063 ("Developer") (1055-1057 Second Avenue and Developer, and their respective successors and assigns, each, a “Party” and, collectively, the “Parties"). RECITALS: 1055-1057 Owneris the owner in fee title of certain land known as 1055 and 1057 Second Avenue, New York, New York 10022, and identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the “Tax Map") as Block 1329, Lots 25 and 26 which is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (the “1055-1057 Owner Land"; the buildings and improvements thereon, together with any Rebuilding (hereinafter defined) thereof, collectively, the “1055-1057 Owner Building"; the 1055-1057 Owner Land and the 1055-1057 Owner Building, collectively, B.Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land known as 1059-1061 2nd Avenue, New York, New York 10022 and identified on the Tax Map as Block 1329, Lots 27 and 28, which is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (collectively, the “Developer Land"). C. Verizon New York Inc.("Verizon") is the owner in fee title of certain land known as 226 East 56th Street, New York, New York 10022 and identified on the Tax Map as Block 1329, Lot 17 (the “Verizon Land"), and the Board of Managers of the 231-235 East 55th Street Condominium (the “Condominium") controls that certain land known as 231-235 East 55th Street, New York, New York 10022 and identified on the Tax Map as Block 1329, Lots 1101 through 1041 (collectively, the “Condominium Land"). D. Pursuant to that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated as of December 16, 1999 and recorded on January 12, 2000 at Reel 3030, Page 435, the Condominium Land and the Verizon Land are collectively a single zoning lot (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter defined) (the “Verizon-Condo Zoning Lot") and are subject to that certain Zoning Lot Development Agreement entered into by the New York Telephone Company, as seller, and 55th and 2nd Realty LLC, as developer, dated December 16, 1999 and E. Developer intends to construct a new building or enlargement on the Developer Land and within the portion of the 1055-1057 Second Avenue Land located, as of the date of this Agreement, above the Cantilever Lower Limiting Plane (as hereinafter defined) (said new building Developer Land and the Developer Building, collectively, the “Developer Premises").
